data.name: Diaab
data.gender_notes: Diaab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Da’abah’, which means ‘to strain, to pull, to be intense or strong’. This name is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Diaab carries the meaning “Intense, Strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Diaab usually hope their child will grow to embody intense, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, determination, and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Diaab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intense, Strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diaab total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta describes a city called Diaab in northern Sudan, which was an important trading center along the trans-Saharan trade routes during the 14th century.
The city of Diaab is mentioned in historical documents from the 16th century, when it was a major center for the slave trade in Sudan.
